events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer a shock 4–1 home defeat by 퀸스 파크 레인저스, with Dennis Bailey scoring a hat-trick. 리즈 유나이티드 overtake them at the top of the First Division with a 3–1 away win over relegation-threatened 웨스트햄 유나이티드. The Second Division promotion race sees 블랙번 로버스 regain their lead with a 2–1 home win over 케임브리지 유나이티드, who drop to sixth in the league. Southend maintain their promotion challenge with a 4–0 home win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who are now just one point clear of the drop zone and faced with the prospect of third-tier football for the first time in their history. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 continue their climb up the table with a 2–0 win at Grimsby , while 포츠머스's promotion hopes are hit by a 3–2 defeat at Plymouth, whose three points help them stay clear of the drop zone. 게리 리네커 receives an OBE and Tom Finney an MBE in the New Year's Honours.

Maidstone United manager Bill Williams admits defeat in his attempt to revive the club's fortunes and reverts to his previous position as general manager. Williams' assistant Clive Walker is left with the task of turning things around for the club, who are kept off the foot of the table only by the shockingly awful seasons being experienced by 올더숏 and 동커스터 로버스.

아스널, defending league champions, lose 2–1 at 렉섬 , who finished bottom of the Fourth Division last season, in the FA Cup third round. Non-league Farnborough Town hold 웨스트햄 유나이티드 to a 1–1 draw at Upton Park, while 크리스털 팰리스 are beaten 1-0 by 레스터 시티.
Terry Butcher , at 33 the youngest manager in the First Division, is sacked by 코번트리 시티 and replaced by his 56-year-old assistant Don Howe .
노츠 카운티 sell Paul Rideout to 레인저스 for £500,000.

Defender Gary Ablett makes the move across Stanley Park to join 에버턴 from 리버풀 for £750,000, on the same day that his new club loses 1–0 to 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford , with an Andrei Kanchelskis goal taking 알렉스 퍼거슨's team back to the top of the league. 리버풀's improvement continues as a 2–1 home win over 루턴 타운 takes them into third place, sending the visitors back into the relegation zone, while 셰필드 유나이티드 climb out with a 4–2 away win over bottom club 사우샘프턴. Coventry draw 2–2 at home with QPR in their first match under the management of Don Howe. Second Division leaders 블랙번 로버스 beat 브리스틀 시티 4–0 at Ewood Park . Brighton keep their survival bid on track with a 3–1 home win over 반즐리. A mid-table clash at Roker Park sees 선덜랜드 beat 밀월 6–2 with Don Goodman scoring a hat-trick. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 have fallen into the relegation zone after being held to a 2–2 draw by 왓퍼드 at Vicarage Road .
Lee Chapman takes Leeds back to the top of the First Division with a hat-trick against his old club 셰필드 웬즈데이 in a 6–1 win at Hillsborough .
Holders 토트넘 홋스퍼 are knocked out of the FA Cup by 애스턴 빌라 in a third round replay. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 struggle to a 1–0 win in their replay against Farnborough Town.
맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat 리즈 유나이티드 1–0 in the FA Cup third round showdown between the leading two teams in the First Division.

리즈 유나이티드 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 both drop points, with 크리스털 팰리스 holding the hosts to a 1–1 draw at Elland Road and 맨체스터 유나이티드 being held to a 1–1 draw by 노츠 카운티 at Meadow Lane . 리버풀 continue to recover their league form with a 3–2 win over Oldham at Boundary Park . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's Second Division campaign continues to go from bad to worse with a 4–3 home defeat to 찰턴 애슬레틱 , who remain firmly in the hunt for a playoff place, as do a resurgent 울버햄프턴 원더러스 with a 3–0 home win over 왓퍼드.
윔블던 sack Peter Withe after three months as manager and replace him with reserve team manager Joe Kinnear .

볼턴 원더러스 sign 19-year-old midfielder Jason McAteer from Northern Premier League side Marine . 맨체스터 유나이티드 regain their lead of the First Division when a Mark Hughes goal gives them a 1–0 home win over 애스턴 빌라.
애스턴 빌라 beat 더비 카운티 4–3 in the FA Cup fourth round at the Baseball Ground . 렉섬 hold First Division 웨스트햄 유나이티드 to a 2–2 draw at Upton Park .
더비 카운티 pay a club record £1.2million for striker Marco Gabbiadini, just four months after he joined 크리스털 팰리스.

맨체스터 유나이티드 are still top of the First Division as January ends, with a two-point lead over 리즈 유나이티드 and a game in hand. After four straight league wins, 리버풀 are third, but remain eight points off top place. 루턴 타운, 사우샘프턴 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 occupy the bottom three places. The Second Division promotion race is being led by 블랙번 로버스, while 사우스엔드 유나이티드's unlikely promotion challenge continues as they occupy second place. 입스위치 타운, 미들즈브러, 레스터 시티 and 케임브리지 유나이티드 lie in the play-off zone. French striker Eric Cantona rejects the offer of a contract with 셰필드 웬즈데이 after a trial period.
